notes.title: "Slime Princess" v1.2.2 official version update log
notes.notes:
"Slime Princess" v1.2.2 official version update log:
[√] Reduced death penalty, changed to resurrection in the nearest initial level after death
[√] Enhanced growth system, retaining current weapons, props and maximum health after resurrection
[√] Added the ability to control the throwing distance of bombs when the player crouches and looks up
[√] Removed the "Add to Wishlist" floating link in the upper left corner of the menu interface
[√] Added keyboard keys 1 to 5 to switch weapons, props, bombs, keys, and gold coins
[√] The power switch in the room is changed to rebound the player but does not deduct health
[√] The appearance of the enemy's special effects and the time for the enemy to spawn are slightly faster
[√] Optimized the problem of too high key explosion rate
[√] Solved the bug of the underground kingdom level boss entrance room being stuck in the wall when teleporting
[√] Solved the bug that some enemies detected that the player would float when they first appeared

notes.title: "Slime Princess" v1.1.5 demo version update log
notes.notes:
[b] "Slime Princess" v1.1.5 demo version update log: [/b]
[√] Added the function of players being able to teleport between explored rooms
[√] Added 2 new breakable pottery jars in the dungeon room
[√] Added neutral elements such as spider webs and flags in the dungeon room
[√] Added some traps in some rooms
[√] Optimized the item reward mechanism
[√] Players can now attack and use props by clicking the mouse
[√] Fixed the problem that the volume suddenly increased when the menu was opened when the game volume was turned down
[√] The sprint function of Slime was added to the teaching level
[√] The way to open the Slime Heart interface was added to the teaching level
[√] Fixed the problem of the texture display in some rooms

notes.title: "Slime Princess" v1.1.4 DEMO Version Update Log
notes.notes:
[b] "Slime Princess" v1.1.4 DEMO version update log: [/b]
[√] Solved the problem that the player cannot jump down when standing on the edge of the small platform
[√] Optimized the problem that the black and white switching contrast is too large when entering the setting interface from the game main interface, causing eye fatigue to the player
[√] Added the player's forward sprint function (controller RT key, keyboard H key)
[√] Added the player's backward sprint function (controller LT key, keyboard N key)
[√] Added sprint game special effects
[√] Added sprint sound effects
[√] The key modification function of Slime sprint was added to the custom key panel
[√] The tutorial level added a gameplay tutorial of bombing stone blocks
[√] The treasure chest monster follows too closely, reducing the movement speed
[√] Fixed the problem of monsters spawning in relatively narrow places
[√] Added a "restore to default" button to the language, audio, and video interfaces
[√] The area of ​​the small map in the upper right corner is increased by 10%, and the border brightness is optimized
[√] Added automatic pickup function for coins, keys, and bombs
[√] Fixed the bug that coins, keys, and bombs would float in the air if they were too far away
[√] Added particle effects to the magic book
[√] Solved the bug of repeated generation of magic books
[√] Solved the problem of the upgrade key positions in the magic book being messed up after switching certain key positions
[√] Added the function that the item attribute box prompt will be displayed only after all items fall to the ground
[√] Reduced the damage collision box of monsters and bosses to reduce accidental injuries and improve the player's fault tolerance
[√] Added additional air walls to improve the game's fault tolerance
[√] Added some secret room doors that do not require keys
[√] Redrawn the entrance door texture of the secret room
[√] Optimized the problem that the sound effect of the laser shot by the floating wizard's skill 2 cannot be turned off
[√] Added a red screen prompt when the player's health is low
[√] Added a full health function to the exit room of each floor
[√] Added 10 new dungeon rooms
[√] Wishlist reminder text is slightly larger
[√] Updated player thank you list
[√] Players can now attack and switch by clicking the mouse
[√] Fixed the issue where the volume would go up when the player turned the volume down very low and opened the pause menu
[√] Added sprint function tutorials to the tutorial level (sprint back, sprint forward)
[√] Added hints to the tutorial level Slime Heart tutorial
